text:
Sam (PM): Quick sync — we need to pick sequencing for the Model Pinning work. Do we ship API-first (low dev friction for engineers) or Console-first (better for customer onboarding & sales demos)? Asking RICE-minded folks for input.

Alex (Eng): API-first so teams can integrate fast. lower effort to expose endpoints, can iterate on UX later.

Priya (DevEx): +1 API-first but we need minimal examples and a small onboarding guide or folks will hit friction. Could we ship a one-page console walkthrough alongside?

Ben (Lead Eng): Quick RICE sketch I did:
```
API: Reach=800 users/mo, Impact=6, Confidence=0.8, Effort=5 -> RICE≈(800*6*0.8)/5=768
Console: Reach=250 users/mo, Impact=8, Confidence=0.6, Effort=3 -> RICE≈(250*8*0.6)/3=400
```
Numbers fuzzy but shows API-first wins on RICE.

Maria (Design): Console has higher perceived polish and reduces support asks for sales-led customers. If we delay Console too long we might lose ARR. Can we do a shallow Console MVP (pin list + pin modal) that hooks to the same API?

Sam (PM): Good point. We're balancing short-term reach vs strategic value for enterprise customers. Constraint: we must ship something that satisfies legal/IT customers who ask for model pinning controls in UI for audits.

Alex (Eng): Technical note: the API surface for pinning is trivial (POST /projects/:id/pins). Console MVP connects to same endpoints, so parallel work is smaller than building independent backends. Effort split: API endpoints 3 dev-weeks, Console shell + modal 2 dev-weeks, QA + docs 1 week.

Priya (DevEx): If we add a small Quickstart and a cURL + SDK snippet, we can cover 70% of developer friction without full Console. That reduces support overhead while we build the UI.

Ben (Lead Eng): Suggestion: API-first gated rollout: expose API to self-serve accounts + internal customers, flag to enable console when account requests it. Canary policy via cloud flag + audit logs. That matches our reliability/fallback strategy.

Maria (Design): I can design the modal in 2 sprints and ship a lightweight pattern library component. I'll prioritize a focused flows doc for SMEs.

Sam (PM): Proposal: Ship API-first with Quickstart (docs + snippets) + Console MVP on a 6-week parallel track. Acceptance criteria: API endpoints documented + SDK examples, Console modal usable for pin/unpin, telemetry for usage, and a support playbook. If no major blockers, roll to beta customers after 3 weeks.

Alex (Eng): OK. I'll update the engineering card with effort estimates and add a canary rollout plan.

Priya (DevEx): I'll draft the Quickstart and a short email template for CSMs.

Ben (Lead Eng): I'll add automated tests for pin enforcement and audit log entries.

release-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging feature-flag rollout at 2025-06-12T16:00Z. :rocket:

Sam (PM): Thanks everyone — we'll treat this as a split-path launch. I'll update the roadmap and RICE sheet. If anyone has objections to API-first + shallow Console MVP, speak now. :thumbsup:
